posts.cooked:
We have test documents that need to be deleted, they are all custom TypeDocs created by us:

  • Construction Draw Requests
  • Change Orders
  • Construction Contracts

These are all submitted test documents. We have Cancel permission enabled for System Manager role, but the Cancel button is not appearing in the UI.

How can I either:

  1. Enable the Cancel button functionality for these DocTypes
  2. Or cancel/delete these test documents in an different way

We need a clean system without test data for production use.

posts.name: volkswagner
posts.cooked:
It’s a good idea to create multiple sites (development, testing, production)

You can then restore from production to testing. This allows you to have a working model for testing transactions, with the ability to restore again and again.

There’s a buil-in function to delete transactions. I haven’t discovered how to easily chose what gets deleted though. I know tax templates get deleted so I export them before running.

You can find it by editing the company record then choosing delete transactions in the action/ellipse menu.

EDIT: I’m still trying to understand how Transaction Deletion Record doctype works. If I try to create one, all of the field are grayed out. Mayb this post will help.

Do be careful, create a backup and save it outside the standard backup directory so it doesn’t get purged.
